Card Q&A.a: Yes. The inherited effect activates as soon as you have 8 cards in your hand, so the Digimon gets +1000 DP for the rest of the attack.
q: I have 7 cards in my hand. I attack with a Digimon that has this card in its digivolution cards, and
from the [When Attacking] effect. I now have 8 cards in my hand. Can I use this card’s inherited effect during the attack to gain 1000 DP for the battle and future security checks?

Inherited Effect: [All Turns] While you have 8 or more cards in your hand, this Digimon gets +1000 DP.
